items.title: Capture无屏RAM和升级资源裁剪
items.current: FW66684已装并验：Capture编译期去掉不用的renderer及256B图像缓存，实际M33结构7952→7424B、静态RAM省528B，应用409116→408996B（省120B），SRAM1余量6520→7048B，预留栈未增；资源CRC/日期/配对/新原音/精确收取及34旧目录不变通过。有屏完整构建通过，编译边界修正前后有屏镜像逐字节相同。
items.next: 本项当前旧板兼容范围关闭；保留presenter诊断状态与950272B UI联合包，不为剩244B或包体另起Boot/布局迁移。新板独立资源边界随原硬件/生产适配再定。
items.benefit: 减少有限RAM占用和无屏设备不必要的升级传输。
acceptance: 776B是相关状态审查范围，不能预先宣称全部可省；保留启动资源校验、版本身份和升级确认。
当前约950KB UI依赖原联合Boot协议，独立资源包须说明兼容/迁移代价；不直接省略现用资源。
Capture/Companion仍共用同一核心，明确真实节省量和受影响功能，无益裁剪不交付。
items.boundaries: 资源收益驱动的优化，非当前已确认故障或新增售卖硬门；保留旧联合OTA兼容。
items.resourcePlan: 优先编译期裁剪，不能用额外常驻抽象抵消所省RAM。

items.title: 录音与屏幕职责解耦
items.current: 实际资源修改将renderer、绘图回调/帧提交及缓存限定在有屏编译分支；Capture/Companion仍同一核心，录音/存储/连接所有者和poll顺序保留。未引入新状态机、堆分配或复制产品分支。
items.next: 本轮必要职责边界随RAM裁剪完成；其余底层已有回调边界，当前没有证据支持仅为文件长而重写整合调度。后续有真实功能变更再局部抽取。
items.benefit: 以后修改Capture不容易误改Companion屏幕，也降低WBA25适配重复工作。
acceptance: 只抽实际变化涉及的协调点，不以行数长为由重写调度。
采音/存储/连接所有者和调用顺序保持可核对，同功能不新增堆分配或重复状态。
按受影响范围验证，Capture与Companion保留同源选择，不复制固件分支。
items.boundaries: 维护性优化候选，随实际功能修改推进，非独立大重构或新平台工程。
items.resourcePlan: 抽函数/职责边界优先，不引入运行时多态、通用事件总线或第二套配置。

items.title: 用户主动删除不需要的设备录音并释放空间
items.current: cfedd31/FW66685正常OTA与选场取消/删除/回收后再录通过，应用409252B（+256B）、常驻RAM无增。Windows普通053/2ba08c56实机Cancel保留、选删回收、目录即时更新均通过；最终34旧元数据逐条不变，剩余4608000B。先前“worker未绑定”的审查误判已纠正，复用原worker与packet；手机用户链仍未通过。 Android055普通系统配对/逻辑目录已验，e6删除后目录和空间恢复；e7真实点击取消后仍保留，再仅收e7到手机4754B原音SHA匹配并精确消费，34旧目录逐条一致、原空间4608000B恢复。首个e6确认点击者未观察，不当取消成功；e7取消有实际输入和结果。
items.next: 本批设备/Windows隔离候选/已装Android055范围通过；不重复这些路径，日用Windows合并发布沿前端原批次。继续当前手机远程开录缺陷、维护和OTA，不把它们藏进本项关闭。
items.benefit: 误录或不需要的录音可直接删掉腾空间，不必先全量下载或恢复设置。
acceptance: 选择逻辑会话，显示实际日期/时长/释放量；物理切段不冒充多场。
取消不改数据；一次普通明确确认仅作用于选定已结束会话，不自动开录或清其它场。
复用现有存储事务，实际回收及目录更新后才报告成功；正在录的会话、同步中或升级占用按实际忙状态处理。
保持正常同步后消费、原音/日期与现有按键路径；只测试本轮新录音。
items.boundaries: 恢复默认设置/解除配对仍与永久删除原音分开；不新增行政审批、默认清空、强制先同步或旧录音空目录要求。
items.resourcePlan: 复用已有预览/删除worker和互斥工作区；实际编译给出RAM/Flash变化，不新造第二套目录/删除数据库。

items.title: 从设备列表选择一场优先收取
items.current: Windows普通列表“接收这场”仅收新e5，2040ms/32640有效样本耐久保存校验并精确回收；未选34旧目录保持，暂停自动同步选择未改变。Android已有原整场接收后端，53逻辑场次入口待实机配对后确认。 Android055普通系统配对/逻辑目录已验，e6删除后目录和空间恢复；e7真实点击取消后仍保留，再仅收e7到手机4754B原音SHA匹配并精确消费，34旧目录逐条一致、原空间4608000B恢复。首个e6确认点击者未观察，不当取消成功；e7取消有实际输入和结果。
items.next: 本批设备/Windows隔离候选/已装Android055范围通过；不重复这些路径，日用Windows合并发布沿前端原批次。继续当前手机远程开录缺陷、维护和OTA，不把它们藏进本项关闭。
items.benefit: 积压很多场时，可以先拿今天急用的一场；同步暂停后能有明确选择。
acceptance: 列表按逻辑会话汇总日期、时长、完整/录中/未收取状态，未知日期如实保留。
只收用户选中的会话，断连后沿原key续收，未选内容不读音频不消费。
接收端耐久保存和校验后精确回收封口段；暂停/继续不误停采音。
多接收端资料去向沿既有单活动端/备份规则，不承诺设备已回收的原音能再次下载。
items.boundaries: 这是App入口与联动缺口；不恢复屏幕上的离线文件管理、不擅自重开CP09-07多主机并发或新增云同步。
items.resourcePlan: 复用分页目录和现有精确收取状态，设备不增加录音目录副本。

items.title: 手机独立完成设备恢复设置与固件升级
items.current: Android055/a39c44ed与后端8e8a82c已安装，普通系统配对和目录实际通过。维护及OTA源码/主机协议检查已完成，66686正常签名整包可用；手机切回其它应用前未开始OTA，不把原生状态检查当真实升级通过。

items.benefit: 售后修复和设置恢复可用手机完成，不要求用户准备Windows或调试线。
acceptance: 普通设备页可恢复默认/清配对，明确保留原音；不把重启或改名称恢复出厂。
手机选择匹配设备的已签名整包，显示下载/设备安装/运行版本结果；仅传输100%不冒称升级成功。

items.boundaries: 补原任务现行依赖与入口缺口；不因此重开重启原因调查、旧升级故障遍历或Owner已暂停的电源实测。

sources.usedFor: 保留已定长按/短按标记；不能把不同机型功能混成统一必需项，不加振动。

sources.title: Notta官方自动转写开关与使用条件
sources.fact: 可关闭设备录音自动转写，已同步录音显示未转写，之后手动处理。
sources.usedFor: 收取保存与AI处理独立；不靠订阅或云服务可用性决定能否录音/收取。

sources.title: Plaud官方转写额度与录音传输独立
sources.fact: 转写额度用完仍可录音、传输及导入，传输本身不消耗转写分钟。
sources.usedFor: 无网/无AI配置的录音、收取、回听联合验收。

sources.title: Plaud官方可选跨端云同步
sources.fact: 开启云同步后跨App/Web/Desktop访问；关闭阻止后续上传，云端删除和本地保留可分别管理。
sources.usedFor: 跨端资料归属/备份和明确上传选择；不擅自把私人原音上云。

sources.title: Notta Memo Pro官方Wi-Fi自动云同步
sources.fact: 该型号有2.4GHz Wi-Fi，可在受信网络自动上传，录音开始会暂停自动同步。
sources.usedFor: 专用硬件差异；现WBA55/Capture不凭固件添加Wi-Fi或4G。

sources.title: Plaud官方设备丢失与Find My条件
sources.fact: 设备无GPS；兼容机型需事先设置Apple Find My才使用其网络定位。
sources.usedFor: 范围内蓝牙找回和专用定位网络区分，沿原硬件/生态条件。

approvedCoreInteraction20261110.ownerRaw:
三个核心功能

一键录音（手机模式）： 按一下开始或停止。敲两下机身做标记，拿起来自动唤醒，这两项都靠 IMU 识别。
按住说话（电脑模式）： 按住说话，松开就把文字打到当前光标位置，适合 vibe coding。需要做一个 Mac 桌面 App 来接收音频、转成文字。卡没法直接当电脑麦克风用，因为 BLE 不支持。
数据归自己： 录音原文件随时能导出，不强制订阅，转写可以用用户自己的 AI key。还可以开放 MCP 接口，让 Claude 或 Cursor 直接读录音笔记，这点对开发者很有吸引力。

按键不够的问题

用"一个按键 + IMU 手势"补上，不加新按键：
按住 + 甩一下 = 发送并回车
敲两下 = 撤销
摇一摇 = 取消
按住 + 倾斜 = 空中鼠标
空中鼠标精度差、用得少，建议当彩蛋或演讲翻页笔，不要当主卖点。
那个开关建议改成物理断麦的隐私开关，它本身就是卖点；关机改成长按按键。 这个是大概的想法, 好弄吗, 或者说相当于多一路IMU信号通道，然后可以从算法角度多很多创新功能的空间 或者说你看看有啥更好的想法

followup107Review.rawCompleteFeedback:
我是本轮第一次接触 Companion 的临时模拟顾客。我只看了公开介绍、普通输入说明、产品界面，以及所选虚构素材的说明和同文文本；Denzic 规则只读了开头角色分流，未继续读工程规则。以下感受来自这次独立窗口的实际使用，不代表真实购买或长期使用经历。

我原本想做的事，是把一段社区读书会筹备讨论变成能照着办的材料：谁负责什么、何时做完、哪些还没定。我尤其关心活动日期是暂定，不想整理完反而把它说成已经确定。我选了明确标记为合成音频的“虚构素材-项目讨论”，54 秒。因为同文文本也公开提供，我先看过素材文字；因此这次不是盲听识别判断，也不能代表真实多人会议的识别效果。

我从空资料库点“导入已有音频”，它先带我到“设备与同步”页，再点“选择音频文件”，选好文件后提示音频已保存。我回到“我的记录”，打开这条记录，点“转文字”，等到文字出来，再点“整理重点”。这些步骤都实际完成了，过程中没有需要我自行配置模型或服务。页面告诉我本地转写不上传录音，而智能纪要会发送选定文字给配置的服务，我能理解这两个用途的区别。

这份转写中的人名、报名截止、暂定活动时间、投影设备与纸质讨论卡等内容，都和这段公开素材相符。它几乎没有标点，直接阅读原文有些费眼；整理后的摘要则容易读得多。软件列出了三个待办：小林联系场地、明远整理报名表、小林问清楚投影设备。预算、不收费、没有投影的替代办法也单列出来。这确实替我做了从一段口语到条目材料的整理工作。

我一开始在待办附近没看到活动暂定的提醒，担心只拿这几条出去会漏掉条件。我展开“查看重点和完整整理”后看到了完整摘要：11 月 22 日下午两点是暂定，活动日期需要等场地回复才能确定。这个条件保留得清楚，我没有遇到它把暂定日期写死的问题。报名截止 11 月 18 日晚八点也在摘要里，不过没成为单独待办。对我这次的目的，完整摘要比只复制待办更合适。

我也点了“整理当前事项为跟进草稿”。它把三条事项和负责人排成了可复制文字，但时间位置显示“未单独填写，请以事项原文为准”，即使第一条原文里已经有“十一月十六日之前”。我能从正文看懂，但原来以为它会直接给我一份包括报名截止、暂定活动日期和条件的简短跟进文字，实际只是事项清单。我没有发送给任何人，也没有把这些虚构事项标成已完成。

我沿“预览并导出完整内容”往下操作，选了 TXT。第一次预览只有录音文字，后来主动勾选“整理结果”，才把整理与原文一起保存成 exports/读书会筹备-摘要与原文.txt。我打开这个自己导出的文本看过，里面确实有摘要、讨论结论、行动项、原话核对和转写，暂定日期也在。这个文件满足了我带走材料的主要目的。不过“完整内容”这个按钮让我起初以为已经选好了整理，实际仍需要确认勾选；预览还要展开“查看所选正文”，我多找了一步。导出的中文材料夹着 Summary、Decisions、Action Items、Questions、None captured，以及引擎名和毫秒时长，这些内容对我拿去看读书会安排帮助不大，整体不像一份完全收拾好的中文纪要。“Questions: None captured”也让我有点迟疑，因为有没有投影和活动日期待确认，在中文摘要里明明还有未定事项。

看见清单不自动提醒的说明后，我自然想给联系场地加一个提醒，于是点了“导出到日历”。它没有擅自猜年份，而是带到时间确认。我把第一条确认为 2026 年 11 月 16 日前，仅日期。刚填完日期时，界面仍要求有效时间，“使用此日历时间”不可点；输入工具点它也超时了。我后来取消“指定时刻”，就能只确认日期并保存了。这不是最终阻断，但对只有日期的事项，我起初没立即看懂为什么填日期还不够。

保存后日历预览明确显示只可导出 1 项，另外 2 项没有明确日历时间，仍保留在清单。这让我知道不会以为三条都已经进日历。我选择指定提醒日期与时刻，设为 2026 年 11 月 15 日 09:00，看到预览说截止仍是 11 月 16 日前、提醒是 11 月 15 日 09:00（UTC+08:00），然后保存了 exports/读书会场地跟进.ics。保存后又展开了已保存的日历副本，看到了相同日期和提醒。软件清楚说文件记录不代表接收日历已读取，我没有把它当成提醒已生效。我没有打开外部日历或实际导入，也没有等待提醒触发；这些结果未知。

我这次获得的收益是：一段讨论已经变成一份有负责人、条件与原话依据的可带走材料，还有一个我手动确认过的日历文件。主要目的完成了。它给我的印象是能用，但需要我一路辨别清单、完整摘要、跟进草稿、导出选择和日历确认之间的关系；相对 54 秒的一段材料，后半段比我预想的操作多。清单里的两条“查找原文核对（未定位）”也让我注意到不能把所有来源定位都当成现成可靠的跳转；我本轮没有点这些来源按钮，没有验证回听或定位效果。

我停在这里，是因为已经拿到本次要的文件，继续往外部日历操作也超出这个独立窗口体验的范围。我没有因为一个小疑惑立刻放弃，也没有继续逐个菜单遍历。实体卡片、手机、电脑会议录音、宠物、文档补充、AI 问答、真实多人识别、长期检索和安装流程都没有实际体验，不能据此评价。

按公开标价 199 美元，我现在不会仅凭这次体验就下单。软件这次把整理和带走材料做成了，对经常需要会后跟进的人有吸引力；但我体验的是一段很短、很清楚的合成音频，本来就不难人工整理，还需要自己处理时间与导出。我没有亲手用过录音卡，无法知道随身录音、同步和真实环境音质是否足以让我额外付这笔钱。云服务额度、税运和正式售后也没有公开在本轮材料里，所以总使用成本仍不清楚。如果实际录音卡能稳定省去录音与传回电脑的麻烦，并且长一点的真实讨论也能保持这次对暂定条件的准确表达，我才会更认真考虑。此次判断是暂不购买，保留兴趣，不是已经证明它不值 199 美元。

residualAudit.method: Assign reference-side substitutions/deletions in one minimum Levenshtein alignment to their original whole utterance. Fully contained utterances are distinguished from clip-edge-straddling ones. Insertions are not assigned to an arbitrary reference boundary.
residualAudit.limits: Repeated fillers can have multiple equally optimal alignments. This checks that clip edges alone do not explain residual omissions; it is not clean-waveform proof, isolated pure-overlapCER or a product result.

directionDecision.finding: Correct target-active timing reduces false words but does not repair this extraction+ASR pipeline. Its excess omissions remain in fully contained utterances, so clip edges alone do not account for the failure. Stop treating activity-head improvement as a sufficient solution.
directionDecision.causalLimit: The controlled inputs support a relative failure of this separated-waveform+ASR combination. They do not uniquely identify waveform distortion versus recognizer sensitivity, prove all internally conditioned separators fail, or establish general meeting<5%.

review.compressionInterpretation: FLAC/source PCM exactly preserved. Host stereo32kbpsOpus is lossy; this same-GSS comparison measures its effect in this screen. It is not the current firmware mono CELT bitstream or a codec-rate sweep.
limitations: NumPy CPU reference is not measured CuPy/AMD-GPU parity or author full WPE pipeline;WPE deliberately off.
Exactly channels0/1 from an8mic public array; no verified acoustic-port geometry match to the close recorder pair.
New overlap arms share the same predicted waveform activity gate;misses remain charged. This is not an adopted hard-gating product policy.
Matched mono_activity is an activity-only baseline, not the best available single-mic separator. CachedPS4 uses a different pipeline/segmentation; both comparisons are reported.
No ground-truth per-root backend selection, text/filler cleaning or hypothesis deletion.

decision.actualValidation: Processed real original channels0/1 from pinned complete lossless AISHELL-4 sources, prior predicted nativeFP16 speaker journal, one fixed GSS reference and unchanged native1.7B ASR. Compared matched mono activity-only, rawdual spatial separation and decodedhostOpusdual; then one evidence-triggered no-hard-gate control on all6existing target lanes.
decision.dataScope: 90s original roots: two30s overlapping excerpts of one exposed Mandarin meeting, including the disclosed1.900779s triple supplement, plus30sordinary from another meeting. Spatial estimation uses15scontext eachside. This is not cross-corpus/general meeting qualification.

compressionConclusion.lossyOpusControl: Hostlibopus32kbpsstereo,20msCBR,lowdelay,complexity0; all input channels/timeline decoded before analysis. Not current-board monoCELT bitstream.
compressionConclusion.meaning: DecodedPCM is necessary but cannot recreate information discarded by lossy coding. In this fixed screen compression increased errors. FLAC/source compression was lossless and cannot explain the older baseline errors. Phase and amplitude both change; this does not isolate phase as the sole cause.

activityFailure.case: Lroot27reference002-F has only1.6681of5.6539targetseconds inside its predicted activity; eight entirely interior reference characters have no retained audio under the hard gate.
activityFailure.interpretation: Gating can erase missed target speech, while removing it restores some content but admits extensive other-speaker text. Neither posthoc word deletion nor selecting gated/ungated text per person is acceptable. Existing activity prediction and target isolation remain actual unresolved gates.

decision.retained: Preserve rawdual as one promising research direction, protect current ordinary and product defaults, retain all27generated condition rows and oldPS4/small-head failures. Do not install the hard-gated or ungated prototype as a finished meeting backend.

methodAndRuntime.algorithm: One pinned GSS NumPyCPU reference of author formulas;20iterations+1post,1024/256Blackman,15scontext,fixedrefchannel0,MVDR+BAN,WPEoff. No parameter,codecrate or channel-pair sweep.
methodAndRuntime.timingScope: Sum of this owned finite experiment process families, all compared conditions included; excludes manual analysis/source download/preparation/publishing. Not stop-recording-to-summary latency or a whole-meeting speed claim.

limitations: Fixed midpoint-utterance clip edit counts retain/report edge-straddling references; not strict full-recordingCER or pure-overlapCER.
Two microphones from a larger public array do not verify the close recorder ports, synchronization/calibration or encoded transport.
New mono_activity is an activity-only comparison, not state-of-the-art single-mic separation;oldPS4 is reported separately.
The research common hard activity gate exposes false-negative limitations and is not adopted as a product rule.
Host stereo codec result is limited to this frozen setting; recording capacity, battery and microphone phase preservation still require product engineering.
No phone/card installation, customer hearing trial, final-holdout opening or sale qualification occurred.

decision.next: 继续原RM-OVERLAP：停止把“更准分人→固定双路GSS→ASR”当作完整修复，保留其空间辅助价值和本轮全自动基线。下一项是从已可复现的开源目标说话人提取骨干准备单一“说话人身份/活动+双路空间线索”联合前端，训练数据仅用真实训练会议及目标缺席负样本，独立会议验证，先固定协议再运行；评价逐人文字保留、非目标串话和普通讲话回退，不只看声纹/MOS。先验证一个联合方案再决定是否扩大微调，不扫模型/参数、不把官方活动辅助结果算成绩。保留原严格<5%、纪要事实、双端实卡和售卖OPEN。

oracleActivityDiagnostic.hypothesis: Fixing activity/identity alone is sufficient only if the fixed separator substantially recovers the missing target words without residual severe leakage. This is causal diagnosis on exposed clips, not an attainable accuracy guarantee.
oracleActivityDiagnostic.timeScope: The observer-error attempt exited before publishing a per-stage result; its separate wall duration is retained instead of silently counting it as zero. Unique completed GSS receipts do not count interrupted/recomputed algorithm calls.
oracleActivityDiagnostic.conclusion: True reference activity/identity does not solve this fixed separation+ASR combination:237/698 diagnostic edits remain, medium-room105automatic→121oracle worsens while small-room256→116 improves. This is not a pure separator upper bound or a directly attainable product accuracy. The control also shows some participant deletion regressions versus its matching oracle-mono control. Do not propose diarization-only repair as sufficient.

largestFullyInteriorOmission.note: Other active voices may be real overlap as well as wrong identity; this audit proves target absence on both channels, not that every other active slot is a label swap.

proof.reason: Previous controller interruption after WAV close before receipt publication. Exact frozen original PCM and activity mask reproduce every sample.

purpose.hypothesis: If true activity/identity still leaves substantial speaker words missing or contaminated, fixing diarization alone is insufficient; spatial front end also needs a different separation design. If much improved, prioritize robust identity/activity before more separator models.

ownerIndependentDualMicValidation2026110.next: 继续原RM-OVERLAP：停止把“更准分人→固定双路GSS→ASR”当作完整修复，保留其空间辅助价值和本轮全自动基线。下一项是从已可复现的开源目标说话人提取骨干准备单一“说话人身份/活动+双路空间线索”联合前端，训练数据仅用真实训练会议及目标缺席负样本，独立会议验证，先固定协议再运行；评价逐人文字保留、非目标串话和普通讲话回退，不只看声纹/MOS。先验证一个联合方案再决定是否扩大微调，不扫模型/参数、不把官方活动辅助结果算成绩。保留原严格<5%、纪要事实、双端实卡和售卖OPEN。

laterAcousticValidation.singleSource: 一只扬声器播放整段混合多人录音可验收回放采音、编码、上传和转写链路，不能证明按不同方向区分不同发言人。
laterAcousticValidation.spatialSeparation: 至少两个独立声源，分别播放不同人的声音，或真人分别发言；三人重叠另验。先确认录音卡分别保存两路且时间一致；回放域与真人现场成绩分别报告。
laterAcousticValidation.hardwareStatusOnly: board_turn status观察到1项现有占用，mayClaim=false；未访问ST-Link/COM/BLE或改固件。

ownerAcousticPlaybackClarification202611.interpretation: 声纹条件神经掩码参与多麦空间滤波是候选方向，不是本机已实现或达标的模型。上一轮真值活动辅助仍237编辑错误，不重复原GSS/门控参数试验。
ownerAcousticPlaybackClarification202611.next: 继续原RM-OVERLAP的单一联合提取候选：由同场说话人样音生成目标声学线索，再与原始双路空间信息共同估计提取滤波，固定同一ASR逐人比较；不能把现有单路PS4直接标成双路模型，也不以二值活动门控预先丢掉弱声。先用现有真实数字双路原音验证，不依赖扬声器；有效后再安排双路独立保存和真实采音全链条。保留原失败、普通讲话回退、严格<5%、纪要事实及双端实卡售卖未完成门。

purpose.decisionBasis: Two new meetings automaticGSS403→361 edits, true activity still237 and one meeting regression. Repeating binary activity/GSS or monoPS4 alone is excluded. New controlled variable is speaker-conditioned spectral masks driving original dual-channel beamforming, with matched neural-mono and strongest cached control.

protocol.separation: Unmodified complete author build_model/extract_speaker, exact matching state tensors, strict load, FP32/eval, matching embedded ECAPA encoder. Both mixture/enrollment separately peak-normalized as official CLI. Every predicted active person with automatically chosen same-meeting solo anchor is extracted. No reference/name/count or output-track deletion.
protocol.asr: Same pinned native1.7B/BF16/eager/greedy512/Chinese/no-context and bounded raw-preserving recovery. Every extracted lane is transcribed; exact-zero pipeline guard only. Source mixture full-ASR cache retained, not re-recognized.
protocol.scoring: Replace only selected original30s root text in the existing complete per-person Document, leave all other full-meeting text unchanged, then score against the entire original reference. All duplicate/missing/incorrect lanes count. Report global cpCER and independently fixed full-speaker DER mapping/unknown-unmatched diagnostic; no per-clip oracle mapping or boundary-word discard. Categories use full reference utterances, not a claimed pure overlap-word score.
protocol.retainRule: Require fewer whole-L fixed-mapping/unknown-unmatched content edits than the frozen baseline, no worse full-S ordinary control edits, and no new complete-execution failure. Otherwise retain raw outputs and reject scaling this exact candidate; no threshold/window/enrollment sweep. Improvements are development component evidence, never full<5%, final holdout or sale acceptance.
protocol.singleSpeakerProtection: Ordinary production route retains source recording; forced extraction is an explicit damage control, not silently applied by default.
protocol.preparationFailure: Original model attempt stopped on missing torchaudio before weights or any inference. Pinned unmodified official Python frontend added only to separation-worker path; standard PCM wave I/O and native Torch are unchanged. No model/audio/retention/scoring setting changed.
protocol.fullRoute: Every predicted-overlap root, all predicted-active enrolled people, same native encoder top1 self-identity check against all6 frozen automatic anchors. All rejected raw lanes retained; no hard time-activity masking. If no lane admitted in a root, retain its full original transcript. Other roots retain original whole output. Same thresholds/model/ASR as routed component, no per-root winner selection.
protocol.fullRetentionRule: Report full-L fixed global DER mapping/unknown-unmatched and standard cpCER, all-person errors, short utterance and overlap-context categories separately. Any total regression rejects this whole candidate, no per-root model cherry-picking. Ordinary source route stays byte-identical. Short-person regression and absent/unregistered speakers remain explicit even if total improves; no formal5% or sale pass from this one development meeting.
protocol.algorithm: Unmodified matching FP32/eval PS4 cue model on original mic0. Non-overlapping <=30s context chunks, separately author peak-normalized and output restored to original mic amplitude. Neural time-frequency target ratio |S|²/(|S|²+|Y0-S|²+eps), clipped to[0,1], drives pinned MVDR-Souden/BAN on ORIGINAL paired0/1 STFT1024Blackman/256/fade, reference0. No GSS EM, activity gate, neural output admission or word filtering. All known people counted. Ordinary bypass original mic0 on both arms.
protocol.activity: Existing full nativeFP16 diarization only. The identical predicted lexical-segment sample mask is applied to every overlap arm, including the mono baseline, after spatial processing. This is a bounded segmentation-controlled research screen, not a new production hard-gating policy; all missed words outside the prediction are charged. No reference/oracle activities or words enter processing.
protocol.ordinary: First predicted single-ID >=25s root in each new meeting; ordinary rawdual bypass is byte-identical to mono. No alternative ordinary window if reference audit contradicts the prediction.
protocol.recognition: Exact prior native1.7B inference AST, same512tokens/BF16/greedy/Chinese/no-context/bounded recovery. All raw generations retained; no filler, duplication or reference-word filtering.
protocol.primaryComparison: Raw paired0/1 fixedGSS versus original0 with identical predicted activity gates. No oracle count/turn/text/slot choice, no parameter or codec sweep. Full per-mic DER and short-span recall reported separately; mic0 always guides separation regardless of reference score.
protocol.retention: To expand to remaining roots: beat cached automaticGSS total216 edits and each root30/186; reduce the lost S002-F deletion count; do not worsen another participant deletions; both ordinary controls remain original PCM/text. Otherwise stop this candidate, keep all absent-person insertions and do not sweep masks/thresholds/models.
protocol.scope: Local pipeline feasibility, not fullCER<5%, pure-overlapCER, current-card dual-mic performance, Android deployment or sale qualification.
protocol.conditionsMeaning: Matched neural_mono vs neural_spatial isolates the spatial filter; both also compared with cached strongest automaticGSS baseline on identical roots. This is NOT a newly trained joint model or a claim the mono backbone accepts2channels.

review.metric: Fixed full-meeting-identity-mapped character edit counts on prediction-selected30s windows; whole midpoint-selected reference utterances, straddling boundaries disclosed. Not strict full-meetingCER or pure-overlapCER.

decision.reasonForStopping: The cue model already adds unwanted text; the static dual spatial output greatly increases insertions. Insertions may include cross-talk and ASR hallucination; this does not attribute every extra character to a specific acoustic source.

trainingProtocol.referenceUse: Supervised official TRAIN samples only. True transcripts/activity enter losses, never deployment inputs. Existing benchmark/finalholdout excluded.
trainingProtocol.architecture: Exact complete PS4 base plus zero-initialized per-band spatial projection of interchannel cosIPD/sinIPD/loglevel. Full separation backbone/mask trainable, speaker encoder and ASR teacher frozen. Mono path supported.
trainingProtocol.preparationStop: No optimizer step until feature parity, independent finite differences, native CE label-shift parity, base zero-adapter exact-output parity and nonzero finite target/separation/spatial gradients all pass. A failed graph is a preparation failure, not a model score.
trainingProtocol.preparationCorrection: Only synthetic numeric FD device corrected: old CPU OpenBLAS aborted under guarded runtime. Same data, objectives, tolerances, model weights and zero-update boundary. Reuse existing validated GPU path, no CPU allocation workaround.
trainingProtocol.optimizer: AdamW, allactualseparationbackbone+zero spatial projections; speaker encoder and recognizer frozen.
trainingProtocol.loss: Present target: frozenrecognizer target-token CE plus normalized annotated noisy waveform preservation/absence loss. Fully absent target: exact-zero waveform loss only, no dependence on a recognizer forced-Chinese blank-token preference. Overlap waveform supervision only outside target annotation; no fabricated clean overlap waveform.
trainingProtocol.qualityDecision: Before/after48heldout TRAIN-source validation inputs, supervised profiles. No gradient updates using validation. Advance to freeASR only if both present-category CE nonregress, absence meanRMS strictlylower and maxRMS nonregress, solo waveform preservation nonregress. This proxy gate cannot qualify a model. Free generations and automatic-meeting profiles remain necessary before any deployment. No LR/epoch sweep or best-epoch selection.
trainingProtocol.scope: One pilot training pass, not generalized/production qualification. Two training sessions and one validation session; physical speaker overlap unknown. Final holdout unopened; product defaults unchanged.
trainingProtocol.memoryCorrection: Only residual-RNN intermediate activations are recomputed during backward. Complete pinned weights, all data/labels, one-pass order, optimizer and learning rates remain identical. Phase/GPU/physical-RAM telemetry added. Output and all 562 trainable parameter gradient groups compared before this trial.
trainingProtocol.checkpointIoCorrection: Same bounded byte-exact weights/optimizer/RNG archive. The whole-train-trajectory bitwise replay diagnostic failed and is preserved, not a prerequisite silently relaxed into a pass. Fresh original weights and before/after validation in one process; all previous32 interrupted updates counted as extra compute. Complete checkpoints saved every16 updates before any optional external diagnostic.

decision.next: 当前候选不进入产品。现有目标存在整体压低声音的捷径，不能靠调学习率、音量或阈值修饰这48条验证。下一项先从公开TRAIN中独立、无重叠的真实语音构造分量精确已知的双人混音（明确是合成混音，不能冒充自然重叠），补足目标讲话时的声音保真和分量一致性监督，并在下一次训练前冻结一份新的、未用于改方案的自然会议验证；不盲换模型。原完整会议<5%、说话人、纪要事实、双端实卡与售卖门继续保持未完成。

objectiveDiagnostic.measuredFact: After/before mean output RMS is strongly reduced in present-solo, present-overlap and absent cases. No word accuracy inferred from loss or amplitude.
objectiveDiagnostic.mathematicalFact: The configured waveform term is exactly zero for an all-zero output on every absent and overlap example. On overlap it supervises only inactive intervals; positive target preservation relies solely on recognizer CE. Zero-output solo waveform loss is explicitly measured as a control.
objectiveDiagnostic.interpretation: Observed broad attenuation is consistent with a silence shortcut in the combined supervision. This does not prove the pretrained backbone cannot extract speakers, nor that ASR guidance is always invalid. Do not repair by a validation-tuned output gain or threshold.
objectiveDiagnostic.nextMethod: Use known target audio components from controlled mixtures of separate real nonoverlapping TRAIN utterances (clearly distinguish synthesized mixtures from natural overlap), add target-present waveform/source consistency supervision with negative-target cases, and freeze a new source-meeting validation split before the next trial. Do not tune learning rate or select a step on these48 examples. Preserve the untouched final holdout.

trainingProtocol.loss: Known positive target: normalized waveformL1 plus mean over256/512/1024 STFT spectral convergence and logmagnitudeL1. Mixedpair: mean of both positive losses plus normalized predicted-sum mixture consistency. Absent identity: normalized absolute output only. Same original PS4 complete backbone and zero spatial adapters; speaker encoder frozen. No ASR teacher loss this trial.
trainingProtocol.advancementGate: Both unseen source meetings must improve mean known-mixture normalizedL1; aggregate positive target normalizedL1 must beat silent output (<1), mixedpair RMS-gain error and single-target waveform loss must not regress, and absent mean output/inputRMS must not regress. If any fail, stop this candidate; no learning-rate/epoch/gain sweep. If pass, decode all frozen new natural queries before/after with the same frozen recognizer and count all target-present errors and empty-target insertions. Supervised enrollment pilot is not automatic-meeting or sale qualification.

qwenBaselineImprovement20261109.decision: Keep Qwen3-ASR1.7B as the retained ASR backbone. Do not immediately replace it, increase model size, change weights or start fine-tuning. Ordinary remaining errors need verified cross-meeting causes; complex overlap requires source/content recovery rather than only another generic ASR checkpoint.

newAudit.interpretation: Groups/tags overlap and are not listening-confirmed causes. Number regex also matches nonnumeric一/点/分; do not call all tagged edits numerical mistakes. Filler/儿 differences are not a justification to delete reference words or change strictCER. Negation and lexical content must be audited separately before adaptation.

improvementOrder: Freeze the native1.7B fixed30s whole-meeting baseline and keep the5.54% boundary variant as a single-meeting candidate; the tested boundary-only change gained19edits and did not cross5%, so no further boundary/threshold sweep without a distinct proven cause.

Check whether persistent substantive errors recur across different real meetings and whether the reference words agree with the original audio before creating adaptation labels. Handle actual names, quantities, negation and lexical mistakes before optimizing superficial score differences. Existing audio coverage/native weight equivalence proofs are reused, not re-run as a ritual.

Where a real user provides agenda, names or domain vocabulary before recognition, test the official prompt/context interface with that source only and preserve a no-context route. Never derive hotwords from reference answers or silently use a language model to rewrite what was said.

For true overlap retain the independent automatic-speaker-profile/separation workpoint: validate the17already-selected profiles, extract predicted simultaneous voices separately, then use the same ASR; ordinary speech bypasses separation. Profile preparation does not establish content recovery.

Fine-tuning/adapter work is justified only after enough independently checked, authorized real-meeting audio/text exposes a stable recognizer error, with meetings/speakers separated between adaptation and evaluation. Freeze old model, protect ordinary content and key facts, and use heldout meetings; no one-meeting memorization.

Replace the backbone only when a mature challenger wins a predeclared same-audio comparison across multiple meetings without protected-path regressions and within measured CPU/system-RAM/device limits. A headline score or one sample is insufficient. No from-scratch foundation-model plan is supported by current evidence.

officialSupport.supports: Native Transformers input supports language and prompt context/hotwords, and documents training/fine-tuning. Context support is not proof of an accuracy gain on our meetings.

findingsReusedWithoutRerun: Correct target timing has already been tested: 256 local reference characters, oracle-gated mixture88 edits vs separated113, fully-contained deletions9 vs28. Activity alone is insufficient; distortion vs recognizer sensitivity not uniquely isolated.

Two independent dual-channel meeting diagnostics showed limited improvement, but 64 interior characters were removed before ASR by predicted activity. Public array microphones are not the actual close-spaced card geometry.
Removing the activity gate recovered some speech but greatly increased other-speaker insertions; removing all filtering is not a solution.

Two adaptation attempts failed content/ordinary-speech protection, including target energy collapse and overlap deletions increasing despite a lower aggregate error. Do not repeat generic epoch/lr/volume sweeps.
Word-time reassignment already worsened cached cpCER, and latest target-conditioned ASR pilot failed real Chinese; neither becomes a new recommended model trial.
ownerBottleneckFirstDirection20261109.executionCorrection: The November8 oracle decision already prescribed matched real near/far data. Subsequent execution returned to new model trials before completing that prerequisite. This reset resumes the missing work, not a newly discovered architecture.
ownerBottleneckFirstDirection20261109.missingArtifact: One verified genuine Mandarin session with far-field mixture and each person's simultaneous close-talk waveform; identity/channel mapping, clock offset/drift, headset cross-talk and target transcript correspondence must be checked. Enrollment snippets are not the overlapping utterance source targets.

sourceAvailabilityOnly.use: One Eval session for exposed diagnostics only, never training. Future adaptation must use the separate Train split and separate validation meetings/rooms/people as metadata allows.

frozenDiagnosticPlan: Freeze Qwen1.7B ordinary ASR and its decoder/normalization, one existing separation checkpoint and one input convention; do not add model candidates.

Acquire and verify one paired meeting before inference: source hashes/license/split, session/person/channel identities, time offset/drift, cross-talk. Preserve raw recordings. Start with a single far-field channel; public8-channel data does not prove card dual-mic capability.

Use simultaneous non-overlap near vs far with identical target transcripts to isolate the basic acoustic/recognition penalty. Use individual near sources during overlap as diagnostic recognition ceilings after verifying source/reference quality.

Compare each separated far-field person output with the SAME person/time/reference and frozen recognizer as the paired near-source path. Record substitutions/deletions/insertions, extra words when person silent, speech preservation, identity errors, wall time and private memory. A reference-only crop is diagnostic and never a product score.

Keep raw mixed chronological CER separate from per-person CER/cpCER; do not score mixed legitimate speakers against a single person reference or compare incompatible denominators. Global identity permutation only under a fixed documented rule.
Use existing correct-activity controls and failed word reassignment evidence; do not rerun them as the next milestone.

Only after localization, implement ONE module repair and verify on disjoint meetings, preserving ordinary speech. If adaptation is justified, use true matched source supervision and content/absence protection; no large training without a falsifiable bottleneck.

preparedNextEvidence.finding: All8 near references match the corresponding far-person reference characters and speech bounds exactly. Raw audio durations differ22.03s/0.30s; coarse acoustic peaks are mostly20-80ms with some low-correlation windows, so duration difference must not be used as an initial offset. No verified sample-accurate alignment or clean-source SDR.
preparedNextEvidence.nextQuestion: Under the same pinned ASR with full audio coverage, how much error is present on each own-headset recording versus the same conversation at the distant mic? Separate headset bleed/silence insertions and annotation scope; use each recording own timeline. This must guide ASR versus acoustic/separation investment before more model ranking/training.

confirmedDirection: 保留完整原音和真实时间，保证每位参会者的内容有识别机会。

完成后更新原任务与工作点，自动选择下一个最高优先级可执行模块；真实依赖未解决时保留未完成事实并推进不依赖的工作，不反复等待或重跑。
只保留对原音、隐私、升级完整性或已出现故障确有作用的保护；对实际冗余提示、阻断和重复步骤在所属模块中合并或移除，可自动恢复的优先后台处理。
复用已过证据，仅验证本次影响；新功能不默认加入，已有功能和用户录音不擅自删除；外部条件或未测试不写成通过。
需要用户配合时准备好具体步骤后弹窗；已授权的公开或虚构测试无需重复询问；手机只做后端，电池和速度专项继续暂停。
模块完成后先提交具体可验收的实际结果；Owner确认后关闭该模块并自动接续下一个。未获验收或仍有必要工作时保持未完成；等待期间继续不依赖的工作。

customerReview.rawCompleteFeedback:
我是本轮第一次接触 Companion 的临时模拟顾客。我只看了公开介绍、普通输入说明、产品界面，以及所选虚构素材的说明和同文文本；Denzic 规则只读了开头角色分流，未继续读工程规则。以下感受来自这次独立窗口的实际使用，不代表真实购买或长期使用经历。

我原本想做的事，是把一段社区读书会筹备讨论变成能照着办的材料：谁负责什么、何时做完、哪些还没定。我尤其关心活动日期是暂定，不想整理完反而把它说成已经确定。我选了明确标记为合成音频的“虚构素材-项目讨论”，54 秒。因为同文文本也公开提供，我先看过素材文字；因此这次不是盲听识别判断，也不能代表真实多人会议的识别效果。

我从空资料库点“导入已有音频”，它先带我到“设备与同步”页，再点“选择音频文件”，选好文件后提示音频已保存。我回到“我的记录”，打开这条记录，点“转文字”，等到文字出来，再点“整理重点”。这些步骤都实际完成了，过程中没有需要我自行配置模型或服务。页面告诉我本地转写不上传录音，而智能纪要会发送选定文字给配置的服务，我能理解这两个用途的区别。

这份转写中的人名、报名截止、暂定活动时间、投影设备与纸质讨论卡等内容，都和这段公开素材相符。它几乎没有标点，直接阅读原文有些费眼；整理后的摘要则容易读得多。软件列出了三个待办：小林联系场地、明远整理报名表、小林问清楚投影设备。预算、不收费、没有投影的替代办法也单列出来。这确实替我做了从一段口语到条目材料的整理工作。

我一开始在待办附近没看到活动暂定的提醒，担心只拿这几条出去会漏掉条件。我展开“查看重点和完整整理”后看到了完整摘要：11 月 22 日下午两点是暂定，活动日期需要等场地回复才能确定。这个条件保留得清楚，我没有遇到它把暂定日期写死的问题。报名截止 11 月 18 日晚八点也在摘要里，不过没成为单独待办。对我这次的目的，完整摘要比只复制待办更合适。

我也点了“整理当前事项为跟进草稿”。它把三条事项和负责人排成了可复制文字，但时间位置显示“未单独填写，请以事项原文为准”，即使第一条原文里已经有“十一月十六日之前”。我能从正文看懂，但原来以为它会直接给我一份包括报名截止、暂定活动日期和条件的简短跟进文字，实际只是事项清单。我没有发送给任何人，也没有把这些虚构事项标成已完成。

我沿“预览并导出完整内容”往下操作，选了 TXT。第一次预览只有录音文字，后来主动勾选“整理结果”，才把整理与原文一起保存成 exports/读书会筹备-摘要与原文.txt。我打开这个自己导出的文本看过，里面确实有摘要、讨论结论、行动项、原话核对和转写，暂定日期也在。这个文件满足了我带走材料的主要目的。不过“完整内容”这个按钮让我起初以为已经选好了整理，实际仍需要确认勾选；预览还要展开“查看所选正文”，我多找了一步。导出的中文材料夹着 Summary、Decisions、Action Items、Questions、None captured，以及引擎名和毫秒时长，这些内容对我拿去看读书会安排帮助不大，整体不像一份完全收拾好的中文纪要。“Questions: None captured”也让我有点迟疑，因为有没有投影和活动日期待确认，在中文摘要里明明还有未定事项。

看见清单不自动提醒的说明后，我自然想给联系场地加一个提醒，于是点了“导出到日历”。它没有擅自猜年份，而是带到时间确认。我把第一条确认为 2026 年 11 月 16 日前，仅日期。刚填完日期时，界面仍要求有效时间，“使用此日历时间”不可点；输入工具点它也超时了。我后来取消“指定时刻”，就能只确认日期并保存了。这不是最终阻断，但对只有日期的事项，我起初没立即看懂为什么填日期还不够。

保存后日历预览明确显示只可导出 1 项，另外 2 项没有明确日历时间，仍保留在清单。这让我知道不会以为三条都已经进日历。我选择指定提醒日期与时刻，设为 2026 年 11 月 15 日 09:00，看到预览说截止仍是 11 月 16 日前、提醒是 11 月 15 日 09:00（UTC+08:00），然后保存了 exports/读书会场地跟进.ics。保存后又展开了已保存的日历副本，看到了相同日期和提醒。软件清楚说文件记录不代表接收日历已读取，我没有把它当成提醒已生效。我没有打开外部日历或实际导入，也没有等待提醒触发；这些结果未知。

我这次获得的收益是：一段讨论已经变成一份有负责人、条件与原话依据的可带走材料，还有一个我手动确认过的日历文件。主要目的完成了。它给我的印象是能用，但需要我一路辨别清单、完整摘要、跟进草稿、导出选择和日历确认之间的关系；相对 54 秒的一段材料，后半段比我预想的操作多。清单里的两条“查找原文核对（未定位）”也让我注意到不能把所有来源定位都当成现成可靠的跳转；我本轮没有点这些来源按钮，没有验证回听或定位效果。

我停在这里，是因为已经拿到本次要的文件，继续往外部日历操作也超出这个独立窗口体验的范围。我没有因为一个小疑惑立刻放弃，也没有继续逐个菜单遍历。实体卡片、手机、电脑会议录音、宠物、文档补充、AI 问答、真实多人识别、长期检索和安装流程都没有实际体验，不能据此评价。

按公开标价 199 美元，我现在不会仅凭这次体验就下单。软件这次把整理和带走材料做成了，对经常需要会后跟进的人有吸引力；但我体验的是一段很短、很清楚的合成音频，本来就不难人工整理，还需要自己处理时间与导出。我没有亲手用过录音卡，无法知道随身录音、同步和真实环境音质是否足以让我额外付这笔钱。云服务额度、税运和正式售后也没有公开在本轮材料里，所以总使用成本仍不清楚。如果实际录音卡能稳定省去录音与传回电脑的麻烦，并且长一点的真实讨论也能保持这次对暂定条件的准确表达，我才会更认真考虑。此次判断是暂不购买，保留兴趣，不是已经证明它不值 199 美元。
